title: Date extended for Applications for Statutory Positions

source.name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University, Maharashtra

text:
KEY LINES:
Extension of Last Date for Submission of Applications for Statutory Positions
last date for submission of applications has been extended up to 7th July, 2026. The

Particulars Revised Last Date
Last date for receiving the hard copy of the application
Date: 02/07/2026

FULL TEXT:
DR. BABASAHEB AMBEDKAR TECHNOLOGICAL UNIVERSITY, LONERE
NOTICE
Extension of Last Date for Submission of Applications for Statutory Positions
With reference to the Advertisement for Recruitment of 22 Statutory Positions published
by Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University, Lonere, it is hereby notified that the
last date for submission of applications has been extended up to 7th July, 2026. The
original advertisement specified the last date as 2nd July, 2026.
Accordingly, the revised schedule is as follows:
Particulars Revised Last Date
Last date for receiving the hard copy of the application
along with self-attested copies of testimonials at the
University Office
On or before 7th July, 2026
At 5.30 pm
All other terms and conditions mentioned in the original advertisement shall remain
unchanged.
Candidates are advised to visit the University website regularly for further updates.
Place: Lonere, Raigad
Date: 02/07/2026
Sd/-
Registrar
Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University, Lonere
